audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gives Kled levels 2, 3 and first item and calls 1, 4-5 and 6 even, while every why and spike on the page says Fiora owns the lane until two items.
audit.why: whys[0] through whys[5] all describe Fiora winning (parry kills his level-1 commit, guaranteed-crit Vital at 2-3, Vital-refunded Q out-tempos his grab, R wins the all-in, duelist tempo beats his remount); only whys[6] flips it. packet.levelChart is Fiora x6 then Kled, and the win rate is 53.25%.
audit.corrected: win[0..5] and phases[0..5].side -> Fiora; win[6]/phases[6] stay Kled, ratings raised to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, so 'trade when his Q is down' has no length attached.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11/10/9/8/7, Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140/125/110; Fiora W is 24s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[2].d now carry 11s, 140s and 24s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says a Chaaaaaaaarge!!! re-engage 'just feeds you a fourth Vital' and never mentions that it grants Kled a shield; Violent Tendencies' four-attack burst is also never given as a wind-up tell.
audit.why: Riot's text: R grants a shield as he charges, so burst dumped into a fresh charge is partly absorbed. W is a four-attack attack-speed burst with a bigger fourth hit — the animation is the tell, not a cast.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text now says to bait the shielded charge before dumping burst; dontsFull[0].d names the four-attack burst that follows the yank. The Riposte-returns-a-stun claim is CORRECT here — Bear Trap tethers and yanks, which is an immobilizing effect.

edits.before: Grand Challenge (R) lights all four Vitals and the heal zone wins the straight skirmish; if he hits Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R) to re-engage he just feeds you a fourth Vital and a free heal field.
edits.after: Grand Challenge (R) lights all four Vitals and the heal zone wins the skirmish; his Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R) re-engage carries a shield, so bait it out before you dump your burst into him.

edits.before: - Kled Beartrap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Riposte it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — 11s at rank 1; parry the yank and his commit dies. - Riposte: 24s. - Chaaaaaaaarge!!!: 140s, and its shield eats burst — force it out first.

edits.before: His engage hook. Riposte it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His engage hook — 11s at rank 1. Parry it, then commit the pattern.

edits.before: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Kled, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until his bar forces the all-in he loses.
edits.after: Bear Trap tethers before it yanks — parry that and Riposte returns a stun, leaving him stranded on you.

edits.before: Kled wastes Beartrap on a Rope — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Kled spends Bear Trap — 11s with no hard engage. Commit at once.

edits.before: That is Kled's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Being yanked in feeds his four-attack Violent Tendencies burst — sidestep the rope.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Courage refills as he fights — break off and he wins a second HP bar.

edits.before: Burning Riposte on poke — your W exists to delete his ONE key spell; waste it and the duel maths flips against you.
edits.after: Riposte is 24s and it is the answer to Bear Trap — spend it on poke and his next yank goes unanswered.
